title: Collateral contract registration request event
description: This event occurs when a client request a register of a collateral contract.

systemId.title: System ID
systemId.description: Identifier of Pismo on Partner. Composition is prefix pismo + domain

defaultContractCode.title: Default Contract Code
defaultContractCode.description: Is a default contract code where collateral contract will be attached.

signatureDateText.title: Signature Date
signatureDateText.description: Is a date of Contract Signature

dueDateText.title: Due Date
dueDateText.description: Is a due date of Contract

participantOriginAccountIdentification.title: Participant Origin Account Identification
participantOriginAccountIdentification.description: Is a account number of who is providing the resources (Origin)

participantOriginDocumentNumber.title: Participant Origin Document Number
participantOriginDocumentNumber.description: Is a Origin participant document number

participantDestinationAccountIdentificat.title: Participant Destination Account Identification
participantDestinationAccountIdentificat.description: Is a account number of who is receiving the resources (Destination)

participantDestinationDocumentNumber.title: Participant Destination Document Number
participantDestinationDocumentNumber.description: Is a Destination participant document number

typeConstitutionEncumbranceCode.title: Type Constitution encumbrance code
typeConstitutionEncumbranceCode.description: Is a number that defines the type of constitution. 1-Asset 2-Account 3-Collateral Account Management

requesterId.title: Requester ID
requesterId.description: Is a identifier from who is requesting the register of a default contract as according with partner this requesterId is our issuerId

externalId.title: External ID
externalId.description: External identifier for operation provided by client.

correlationId.title: Correlation ID
correlationId.description: External identifier for a request provided by client or by us. This ID will be used handle response events from Partner.
